# Contentdrips

Contentdrips generates branded graphics and carousels from reusable templates through an asynchronous rendering API.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/contentdrips/.

## Actions

- **Get Render Job** (read-only): Get a Contentdrips render job's current state.
- **Start AI Carousel Render**: Generate carousel copy from a topic or supported HTTPS source URL and queue its render.
- **Start Carousel Render**: Queue a manually authored multi-slide carousel as PNG files or a PDF from a known account-owned template.
- **Start Graphic Render**: Queue a PNG or PDF render from a known account-owned Contentdrips template and return the asynchronous job ID.
